title: Carer Support Payment (Scotland)
jurisdiction: Scotland (in England and Wales this is Carer's Allowance)

effective.uprating: The Carer's Assistance (Carer Support Payment) (Scotland) Regulations 2023 (S.S.I. 2023/302) and annual up-rating; earnings limit pegged to 16 hours at National Living Wage (16 × £12.75 = £204)

plainly: Scotland's replacement for Carer's Allowance: £86.45 a week for caring 35 hours or more for someone receiving a qualifying disability benefit. Entitlement also unlocks the twice-yearly Carer's Allowance Supplement in Scotland.

questions.label: Your date of birth
questions.help: Only used against the age condition; it never leaves this page.
questions.rule: Carer's Assistance (Carer Support Payment) (Scotland) Regulations 2023 (S.S.I. 2023/302) reg 13: aged 16 or over

questions.label: Do you live in Scotland?
questions.rule: S.S.I. 2023/302 regs 5–12 (residence and presence in Scotland)

questions.label: Do you spend 35 hours or more a week caring for someone?
questions.help: Add up practical support including personal care, meals, medication, emotional support, and keeping them safe.
questions.rule: S.S.I. 2023/302 reg 14 (regular and substantial caring: 35 hours per week)

questions.label: Does the person you care for get Attendance Allowance, PIP or ADP daily living, DLA care (middle or higher), Pension Age Disability Payment, or Child Disability Payment (middle or higher)?
questions.help: If they have not claimed a qualifying benefit yet, that claim comes first, as Carer Support Payment depends on it.

questions.label: Your own weekly earnings, after tax, National Insurance and allowable expenses (not your partner's)
questions.help: Enter 0 if none. Allowable expenses such as 50% of pension contributions and certain childcare or replacement care costs can be deducted.

questions.label: Your own weekly State Pension (not your partner's)
questions.help: The same figure as your State Pension if you are single; 0 if you do not receive one yet.
questions.rule: Social Security (Overlapping Benefits) Regulations 1979 (S.I. 1979/597) and S.S.I. 2023/302: overlapping benefit rules apply to State Pension

values.plainly: The Carer Support Payment rate (2026–27: £86.45 a week).
values.rule: S.S.I. 2023/302 reg 19 (weekly rate), parity with Carer's Allowance

values.plainly: What would be paid directly: the standard rate less your own State Pension due to overlapping benefit rules.

gates.because: In England and Wales this benefit is Carer's Allowance, claimed from the Department for Work and Pensions.
gates.rule: Social Security Contributions and Benefits Act 1992 s.70

gates.because: Carer Support Payment requires you to be aged 16 or over.

verdicts.because: The amount shown is payable weekly after offsetting your State Pension against the £86.45 standard rate. In Scotland, receiving Carer Support Payment on qualifying dates also qualifies you for the Carer's Allowance Supplement paid twice a year by Social Security Scotland.

You meet all eligibility conditions. Although your State Pension equals or exceeds the £86.45 weekly rate so direct payments are zero, establishing underlying entitlement unlocks the £48.15 carer addition in Pension Credit and qualifies you for carer premiums in local council tax reduction.
verdicts.rule: S.I. 1979/597; S.S.I. 2023/302; State Pension Credit Act 2002 s.2(8)

verdicts.because: Your weekly earnings exceed the £204 limit. Deductions for income tax, National Insurance, half of pension contributions, and necessary care costs while working can be subtracted before applying the test.
Carer Support Payment requires providing at least 35 hours of care per week to a person in receipt of a qualifying disability benefit.

not_asked: the identity of the person you care for
not_encoded: Carer's Allowance Supplement exact payment dates and amounts (paid automatically in June and December to recipients on qualifying dates)
cross-border moves between Scotland and England/Wales (13-week transition run-on)
education conditions for young carers (unlike Carer's Allowance, Carer Support Payment allows certain students in full-time advanced education)
short breaks in care and hospital stays (up to 4 weeks in a 26-week period)

passports.name: Pension Credit carer addition (£48.15 a week)
passports.note: Earned by having underlying entitlement to Carer Support Payment, whether or not direct weekly benefit is payable.

passports.name: Carer's Allowance Supplement
passports.note: An extra payment made twice a year by the Scottish Government to people living in Scotland receiving Carer Support Payment.

sources_checked.what: Carer Support Payment regulations and rates for 2026-27; earnings threshold £204 per week
Carer's Allowance Supplement entitlement criteria and interaction with devolved disability benefits
